icra.full_name: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation

pattern.deadline_window: Paper deadline 15-16 September, 23:59 US Pacific ('PST' as written; PDT/UTC-7 in practice), never AoE. 2024: 15 Sep 2023; 2025: 15 Sep 2024 -> +24 h to 16 Sep; 2026: 15 Sep 2025 (no verified extension); 2027: 15 Sep 2026 -> +24 h to 16 Sep. Accompanying-video upload windows open ~5 Aug-9 Sep and reopen for ~5 days after the deadline. No abstract deadline.
pattern.typical_notification: 31 January (identical in 2024, 2025, 2026, 2027), i.e. ~4.5 months after submission; reviews and AE report released with the decision.
pattern.typical_camera_ready: Early March (6 Mar 2024, 6 Mar 2025, 5 Mar 2027 author registration; 2026 was extended to 31 Mar). PaperPlaza reopens for final uploads ~6-7 February.
pattern.typical_conference_month: Mid-May to early June, 5 days Mon-Fri (13-17 May 2024, 19-23 May 2025, 1-5 Jun 2026, 24-28 May 2027, 15-19 May 2028). Workshops/tutorials on the first and last day.
pattern.location_rotation: Rotates across regions roughly Asia -> North America -> Europe -> Asia -> South America: Yokohama (2024), Atlanta (2025), Vienna (2026), Seoul (2027), Rio de Janeiro (2028).
pattern.review_process: Conference Editorial Board: an Associate Editor recruits reviewers (typically 2-3) and writes a summary report; decisions and reviews are released together on 31 January. Single-blind through ICRA 2025; double-anonymous since ICRA 2026 (author names removed from the PDF, all co-authors still entered in PaperPlaza). There is NO rebuttal/author-response phase.
resubmission_rules: Dual submission: a paper may not be under simultaneous review at another conference or journal; arXiv/preprint versions are explicitly allowed ('papers which have been uploaded on a preprint server (e.g. arxiv) and are not submitted simultaneously to any other conference or journal, can be submitted').
Workshop papers without formal/peer-reviewed proceedings (no DOI) may be resubmitted; workshop papers with a DOI cannot.

The old joint 'RA-L with ICRA presentation option' (submit to RA-L by a conference-tied deadline) no longer exists. Instead, papers published in RA-L / T-RO / T-ASE / RA-M / T-FR / T-RL / RA-P / ToH within an eligibility window (RA-L: transfer within 270 days of acceptance) can be transferred in PaperPlaza for presentation at ICRA; the transfer deadline is ~30 Nov-31 Dec of the year before the conference (30 Nov 2023 for 2024; 31 Dec 2025 for 2026; 31 Dec 2026 for 2027). For a September rejection elsewhere (e.g. CoRL/IROS), ICRA mid-September is the natural next stop; for an ICRA rejection on 31 Jan, IROS (early March deadline) and RA-L (rolling) are the usual next targets.
Page limit: 6 + unlimited references through ICRA 2025; 8 pages INCLUDING references from ICRA 2026 on. Non-compliant final papers are removed from the proceedings without a chance to fix.
Extensions: only ad-hoc 24-hour server-load extensions (2025, 2027) announced on the deadline day itself; the FAQ always says 'There is no plan to extend'. Plan for 15 September 23:59 Pacific.
Presentation is on-site only (2027 explicitly: no online presentation option); at least one author must register by the early-March author-registration deadline before uploading the final paper.

notes: Official page gives the deadline only as '15 September 2023 (PST)' with no clock time; 23:59 is the PaperPlaza convention (ccfddl records 2023-09-15 23:59 UTC-8). No extension was found.

Review: single-blind (medium confidence for this edition: the archived 2024 Call for Contributions does not state it; the 2025 CFP says explicitly 'The ICRA review process is single-blind' and the 2026 CFP says 'Since this year, the ICRA review process is double-anonymous', implying 2024/2025 were single-blind). No rebuttal phase; reviews are visible in PaperPlaza with the decision.
Final (camera-ready) paper window: 7 February - 6 March 2024 (23:59 PST); presenting authors registered by 6 March 2024.

No joint 'RA-L with ICRA option' submission. Instead, published RA-L / T-RO / T-ASE / RAM papers within their eligibility window could be transferred for presentation; transfer deadline 30 November 2023.
Workshop/tutorial proposals: 25 September 2023, 23:59 PST (firm); notification 21 December 2023. Competition proposals: 15 October 2023; notification 31 October 2023.
Page limit 6 pages + unlimited references (6+n). Accompanying video windows before/after the deadline.
IEEE RAS venues archive lists the dates as '13 - 18 May 2024'; the official site says May 13-17, 2024 (trusted).
Record attendance of ~7,000; 1,760 of 3,937 submissions accepted (44.7%, secondary source csconfstats).

editions.name: ICRA 2026
editions.full_name: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
notes: Extension is DISPUTED. mldeadlines.com lists 'Extended deadline Sep 16, 2025' and Google indexes a 2026.ieee-icra.org page titled 'Paper Submission Deadline is Extended to Sept 16, 23:59 PST', but that URL is now 404, was never captured by the Wayback Machine, and the 2026 site was cloned from the 2025 site (it still carries a 'contribute_2025' page and 2025-dated event entries), so it is most likely the inherited 2025 announcement. Evidence for NO extension: the Wayback capture of the CFP on 2025-10-06 (after the deadline) still reads 'Deadline: 15 September 2025 (23:59 PST)' and 'There is no plan to extend'; the official X account's last deadline post is the 12 Sept 2025 'Final Reminder ... 15 September 2025 (23:59 PST)'; ccfddl records 2025-09-15 with no extension; the 2026 Announcements archive has no extension item. Recorded as 15 September 2025, not extended.
Review: double-anonymous for the first time ('Since this year, the ICRA review process is double-anonymous'). No rebuttal; reviews visible with the decision.
Page limit changed to 8 pages INCLUDING references (previously 6+n). Record 5,088 submissions.

Final paper: PaperPlaza opened 6 February 2026; original author-registration deadline 6 March 2026, extended to 13 March 2026 (announcement of 11 March 2026); the final-paper instructions page states an 'extended final deadline of 31 March 2026 (23:59 PST)' for uploads and author registration. camera_ready above is the extended date; the original final-upload date was not captured verbatim (author registration was 6 March 2026).

No joint 'RA-L with ICRA option'. Journal-paper presentation transfer (RA-L, RAM, T-ASE, T-RO, T-FR): the CFP states '31st December 2025' in one paragraph and '30 November 2025' in another (inconsistent on the same page).
Workshop/tutorial proposals: 25 September 2025; notification 21 December 2025 (153 proposals). Arts in Robotics extended to 9 January 2026 (AoE).
Accompanying video windows: 5 Aug - 9 Sept 2025 and 17 - 22 Sept 2025.
Registration: early-bird 31 March 2026; standard 22 May 2026.

editions.name: ICRA 2027
editions.full_name: 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
notes: Deadline EXTENDED by 24 h: original 15 September 2026, 11:59 PM PST (CFP opened 16 July 2026; reminders on 3 Aug and 17 Aug 2026); on 16 September 2026 (08:06 UTC) the organizers announced 'given high server load, the paper submission deadline has been extended 24 hours' to 16 September 2026, 23:59 PST, 'No further extensions are expected'. The CFP now reads 'Sep 16, 2026 (23:59 PST) ... Submission Deadline Extended'.
'PST' is how the organizers write it; PaperPlaza runs on US Pacific time, i.e. PDT (UTC-7) in September - NOT Anywhere-on-Earth. mldeadlines/ccfddl model it as 23:59:59 America/Los_Angeles.

Notification of decision: 31 January 2027 (Sunday). No rebuttal phase; reviews come with the decision. Review is double-anonymous (author info removed from the PDF); 8-page limit including references.

camera_ready = 5 March 2027 is the announced author-registration deadline ('Paperplaza opens for final submission' 6 Feb 2027). The final-upload date is not stated separately; in 2024 and 2025 it coincided with author registration (6 March), so treat 5 March 2027 as the working camera-ready date (inferred). Early registration 31 March 2027; standard 14 May 2027; registration opens early February 2027.
Accompanying video windows: 5 Aug - 9 Sept 2026 and, updated on 17 Sept 2026, 18 - 22 Sept 2026 (23:59 PST) (originally 17-22 Sept).

No joint 'RA-L with ICRA option'. Journal-paper presentation transfer (T-RO, RA-L, T-ASE, T-RL, RA-M, T-FR, RA-P, ToH) deadline 31 December 2026; RA-L's own page gives the ICRA 2027 window as 'March 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026' and requires transfer within 270 days of acceptance.

Workshops/tutorials: pre-proposal 1 September 2026 (AoE); full proposal 1 November 2026 (PST). Competitions closed 1 September 2026. Arts in Robotics abstracts 1 December 2026 (23:59 PST, OpenReview).
On-site only: 'There will be no option to present a paper online.'
Next edition (for planning): ICRA 2028, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, 15-19 May 2028 (IEEE RAS venues archive).
